title: Caramel Pecan Cottage Cheese Bowl | 42g Protein
description: Creamy cottage cheese topped with candied pecans and sugar-free caramel, served with a Built Puff pumpkin cookie protein bar. Ready in 6 minutes.
image_prompt: Two items styled together in one photo. Item one: a bowl of creamy plain cottage cheese topped with a small pile of dark caramel-glazed candied pecan pieces and a light drizzle of caramel sauce. The cottage cheese and pecans are the only things in the bowl -- no bar pieces, no cubes, no crumbs, no crumble of any kind on top of or inside the bowl. Item two, placed on the wood surface right next to the bowl: one full Built Puff Pumpkin Cookie Chunk protein bar, whole and fully sealed inside its original printed retail wrapper. Do not open, unwrap, cut, or crumble this bar -- show it exactly as a sealed packaged snack bar, wrapper fully intact, brand packaging and readable label visible. The two items sit side by side as one styled scene. Warm amber fall light, rust linen napkin, natural wood surface, no fruit or extra garnish.
image_alt_text: Caramel pecan cottage cheese bowl served with a whole Built Puff pumpkin cookie protein bar in its wrapper.
